title.tr: Ortam Değişkeni ve Çok Satırlı Komut
title.en: An Environment Variable and a Multi-line Command

hints.tr: `env:` iki satır: `    env:` ve altında iki boşluk içeride `      APP_ENV: test`.
hints.en: `env:` is two lines: `    env:` and, two spaces further in, `      APP_ENV: test`.

hints.tr: `run: |` satırından sonraki komutlar `run`'dan daha içeride, alt alta yazılır.
hints.en: The commands after the `run: |` line are written one under another, further in than `run`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

**.github/workflows/ci.yml**

```yaml
name: CI

on: push

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      APP_ENV: test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: python -m pytest
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

**.github/workflows/ci.yml**

```yaml
name: CI

on: push

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      APP_ENV: test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: python -m pytest
```
